notes.title: Jack's Back!
notes.content:
[h1]Trick or Treat...[/h1]

It's that spooky time of year again, and Jack O' Lantern has descended onto the Tower to deliver his own brand of trick or treat to you! 

Slaying Jack will get you his very special, limited edition monster card. But be quick! Jack's only around for a short period of time...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/AUwuqcp.gif[/img]

[h1]New Boss![/h1]

Previously, there was a boss every 20 floors with the exception of Floor 80. Now, the terrifying demon Tyrfing has claimed Floor 80 as his own, and you need to strike him down before you can face the final challenge from the Council Of Nine...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jt8yr5c.gif[/img]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

As you may have seen in previous updates from the Once More With Gusto team, there's a variety of different things that are planned for the future of Eternal Step. Things like - 

[list]
[*]Steam Achievements!
[*]Scoreboards!
[*]One Life Mode!
[*]Respawning Bosses!
[*]Ranged Weapons!
[*]Magic!
[*]More Traps!
[*]More Rare Monsters!
[/list]

There's a large patch for the game coming later on in the year, which will also mark a update to a newer version of the engine. This means that there might be some save game issues, but there should be a way to manually import your previous save. We'll keep you updated on exactly what the situation is closer to the update, and let you know how to import the save if that's possible.

Until next time, be sure to tweet out your death tombstones to us - We love it when we see how far you get!

notes.content:
Added  much requested new main boss between the third and last boss on floor 80.

notes.title: Update on Eternal Step and what is coming!
notes.content:
So it has been a while since we updated Eternal Step and there has been a reason. 

We have always agreed to be upfront with any community we have. 

The reason has been really for Paul to secure some more stable work. 

We where running on empty up to the release of Eternal Step and we have had to pause while Paul can feed himself. 

So now this has been done YAY. 

We are back with what to expect going forward. 

We belive Eternal Step is in a much better place now then at launch and that  has been though people like yourself giving us feedback and from us wanting to push content out. 

So the next big update will be coming soon!

What to expect: 

A new boss to fill the void in floor 80 - some people have expressed they enjoy the boss fights and was sad to see no boss was on floor 80. 

So a new boss is going to be added. If you have got past floor 80 you should be able to go back to floor 79 checkpoint and go fight it right away. 

So dont panic if you got past it. 

Bosses respawn - we are looking into a way to have the bosses come back so you can fight them again. 

We had always planned to have them come back on high floors harder and stronger with possibly new moves and this is something we are still planning. 

More rare monsters - So some of you have fought the King Slime etc and we plan to fill out the roster by making sure every enemy currently has a rare version, so expect more of those mini boss fights. 

More traps - we want to add more traps just to mess with you're head

More treasure floors and evil floors - yes more of these are coming

one of the bigger features is going to be ranged and magic weapons so let me explain. 

Ranged weapons and Magic - we plan to add these new systems in the next update this will boost the current amount of weapons by a lot and also mix up the game play quite a bit, however enemies will also be ready for new tactics. 

Ranged weapons and magic cannot be stored like normal weapons can they are more pick up and use items. 

Think along the lines of castlevania with you're sub weapons. 

However you will need to kill rare enemies to unlock new spells and new weapons once you have killed them, the item will get added to the possible drop list. 

going forward we will always see how well Eternal Step is selling and if people want more content!

We have seen quite a lot of new people pick up the game and we want to share to anyone that has it that more is coming. 

So more details soon!

notes.title: Eternal step minor fix update.
notes.content:
Hi sorry for no new content in this patch I have had to work on other things to get money for living. instead this update is for minor fixes (one major) and balancing.

1. Hidden the shield descriptions until you actually get them now (noticed on Indelacio's lets play video.)

2. New shields and armours could be unselectable for certain people. This is because of some old code I got ready for the pages but didn't have the new custom controls code in place. (also spotted by Indelacio.)

3. adjusted hitboxes on certain moves that looked like they didn't hit me but did. All these are smaller so nothing has been made bigger:
Imp fireball
Golem back spear swing
Last boss electric moves
Hound lunge
Master handy slam
Slime under stab
Angelmage flame

4. Sometimes very rarely Handy could achieve incredible feats of speed increasing. They can now no longer go ssj

5. Very minor damage decrease to anything that hits super hard. Very minor though this is like 5% less. Moves like golem spear thrust.

6. Upped the minimum possible attack RNG slightly on weapons dropped in the dungeon.

notes.title: Eternal Step patch - Version 1.25 update
notes.content:
We have added new shields for you to find in the tower and this should help mix up your builds or playing styles.

The next update to come will be the one life mode but at the moment we still have a few things to sort out for that. 

Eternal step is now updated to v1.25. Main new inclusion this time are 8 new Shields.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]New shield Vampire. Hold block to suck up blood and heal some health.
    [*]New shield Fortress. doesn't break but take 5% health per block. 
    [*]New shield Svalinn. Front projectile blocker.
    [*]New shield Reaver. Enemies drop souls. Hold block to collect and heal.
    [*]New shield Grenade. Explodes when shield shatters.
    [*]New shield Liberal. Skills on weapons drop twice as often.
    [*]New shield Neglect. 30% more powerful as long as you don't block. Resets each floor.
    [*]New shield Firin. Hold shield to charge a laser-beam.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]Hitboxes for trapdoor and some fireballs changed to not hit/trigger above you when it doesn't look like it should.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]You can no longer use fragments to create items you have not stored yet.
   [*]Took the decimal point damage out of wisp card.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Step patch - Version 1.2 update
notes.content:
So we start this year with more Loot as Eternal Step see's its first update in 2016. 

Our main goal at the moment is to boost the levels of loot to be roughly the same as swords ( 2 pages worth basicly). this will then pave the way for some of the bigger updates outlined in our 2016 roadmap.

Which if you havent read do so now and get hyped for more hard content. 

The christmass boss as far as me and Paul could see was not defeated and you now will have to wait till christmas 2016 before fighting him again. 

So without any more delay the updates.



Eternal step is now updated to v1.2. Main new inclusion this time are 8 new armours.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]New armour Ninja gear, start each floor invisible for a few seconds.
    [*]New armour Fervent, blood hurts enemies.
    [*]New armour Hero, Upgrades sword beams.
    [*]New armour Verve, 50% more health.
    [*]New armour Steadfast, don't recoil on hits.
    [*]New armour Resurrect, come back to life once.
    [*]New armour Fearless, Half your health to double power (all damage types.)
    [*]New armour Superstition, Higher chance of special floors. 
    [*]New way of showing lore at card selection.
    [*]Skill descriptions on skill selection.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]Level up will now heal you to full health.
    [*]Updated door and brick to show they fragment into two.
    [*]Bigger card zoom size to more easily view the text
    [*]New code to stop the same normal floor variant happening twice in a row.
    [*]Graphics changes to the title screen and some level objects.
    [*]Old lore book removed to make way for the new version.
    [*]Floor 100+ normal floors altered in difficulty. (yes that means harder.)
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Stopped yet another bug that could stop the loot from showing on floor clear.
    [*]Stopped some moves hitting twice when they should only hit once.
    [*]Some spawned chests spawned more than once on top of each other.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Step patch - Version 1.12 update
notes.content:
Christmas boss is now ready to challenge! 

The world of Terra may not celebrate christmas as we do. 

However the City of Omina does exchange gifts between the rich and poor alike to help struggling people make it though the winter. 

They also hold a feast lasting from the 18th December to the 8th January, as ordered by the council of Nine. 

The festive boss is a nod to a myth told to children who get gifts around this time. 

The myth is that a monster lives inside the gifts, and if you are bad it will come out, grab you and pull you into present to be lost forever. 

However if you are good then the present will show you a gift inside instead. 

The council made an actual version of this for the tower. 

Remember if you like lore then read the lore book everytime you get a new peice of gear or fight a monster to learn more. 

--

Thanks for your patience with the delay to game updating. Paul had to take on some other work for three weeks so was unable to fully dedicate his time to the game. We hope everyone enjoys the patch and has a good Christmas holiday. If you don't celebrate Christmas then happy usually get time off work days!

Sadly a new update to the engine has hapepned but that is still in beta, which shown great results for lower end PC performance, was unable to be implemented yet due to old saves not working with the newer update. Hopefully this will be fixed soon then most users should see a noticeable improvement in performance.

We have asked about a fix for this or work around yet currently nothing has come back!



[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]Christmas boss added till the 8th January.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]Thanks to new Christmas boss code, King Slime and Master Handy will spawn enemies based on your level and not floor level.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Taking a skill from a rare would make another rare appear in the loot table, even though you didn't have one.
    [*]Boss 2's Add could work wrong with skills. (still able to hit the eye with the mob dead.)
    [*]Trapdoors before floor 30 would put you into higher enemy floors.
    [*]You could cancel out of trapdoor animation by letting go of a skill.
    [*] Handy pet now less specific with damage numbers. (no more 30.15 damage.)

notes.title: Eternal Step patch - Version 1.1 update
notes.content:
Apologies for the small updates in the upcoming couple of weeks. Other work has stopped me working full time on the game but we should be back to normal in two weeks.

Critical moments have been added!!

We have watched and listened to feedback and now give you a way to know if the boss is close to dead. 

The music in the game will change once the boss hits 20 percent health, this peice of music should get you pumped as you have almost killed the sucker...but then you die..nooooo

Other then that we changed a few things to makes peoples life easyer!

Rare monsters are still coming :)
Also Christmas content is still on the way YAY for Christmas and all the death that will follow.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]New music plays when the bosses are under 20% health.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]Slime appearance altered to look more like king slime. 
    [*]Removed fragment video tutorial to help people get into the game easier.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Possible fix to the rush ability throwing you offscreen sometimes that Th3Jok3r reported.
    [*]Orbbit projectiles should now take less cpu power.
    [*]Stopped Handy hiding in walls sometimes when losing armour.
    [*]Stopped Orbbits from floating into hard to hit positions.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Step patch - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1 released 

As we work towards doing the new rare monsters, this weeks patch is all about upgrading the visuals. 

Following feedback we have changed the look of the visuals and enemies etc. 

We feel this looks better and is closer to what we wanted to do in the first place. 

Other then that we have a few fixes and balance tweaks. 

We are also working on a way to tell you that a boss is almost dead :)
After watching a few people tackle bosses, the common question was "are they almost dead" or "how well am I doing"

So this change is also coming. 

Rare monsters is still about 2 weeks away so get geared up for the hunt. 

[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]Art update for character animations. The main character and enemies will now not just have flat block colours.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]New minimum damage for floors applied. (To stop higher floors killing heavy armour builds 1.) 
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Change floor triggering all imps will now work properly.
    [*]Floor variant 125 door would open before all enemies were dead, now it doesn't.
    [*]Will D wisp explosions will no longer give exp.
    [*]Blocky card will now work on Encho's projectiles. Because he isn't that special.
    [*]Jacks maze will now be visible on low settings. thanks to Fantasy Batman for pointing that out.
[/list]

[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]New minimum damage for floors applied. (To stop higher floors killing heavy armour builds 1.) 
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Change floor triggering all imps will now work properly.
    [*]Floor variant 125 door would open before all enemies were dead, now it doesn't.
    [*]Will D wisp explosions will no longer give exp.
    [*]Blocky card will now work on Encho's projectiles. Because he isn't that special.
    [*]Jacks maze will now be visible on low settings. thanks to Fantasy Batman for pointing that out.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Step Update 1 part 2 Extended
notes.content:
Well you guys are massively lucky this week, we have managed to squeeze in a few new floors before the end of the week. 

This now ends this bit of the update ( however doesn't mean we wont add more in the future) 

So we have now happily doubled the amount of treasure/Evil floors you can now get with more towards treasure. 

we felt we should have more treasure floors then evil as the game can be quite tough as it is.

So increasing the pool just means you have more chance of a good floor then a bad one so YAY.

The three new floors added again will slot into the game and you can get them at whatever stage you are at currently in the tower.

We still haven't seen anyone beat floor 100 yet!

[b]Beat the horde[/b]
waves of enemies will try and kill you and you must beat every wave to get the reward, however should you fail...well then your dead!

[b]Reach the end[/b]
Simple right? However this room is filled with spikes and other nasty traps and will require you to time your movement and your dodges just right or risk death. 

You could try BFH ( brute force healthing) your way though but then you would be wasting your potions. Your choice.

[b]Catch the cards[/b]

cards will rain from the sky, loot cards, rare cards and fragment pieces will fall as well.

catch the card before it hits the floor to secure your reward!

Not only that but once again we have fixed some bugs and thanks Moiren who has found and reported a few bugs which has helped us quite a bit.

So thank you and look forward to seeing your floor 100 clear. 

So NEXT WEEK IS WEAPONS

So far the game only has rarity rank 2 weapons some of the ones coming in the future will be amazing and very hard to get :) 

Until next week. 

Version 1.07 released 

[b]New[/b]
[list]
    [*]New evil floor beat the horde.
    [*]New evil floor reach the end.
    [*]New treasure floor catch the cards.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
    [*]Chests updated visuals.
    [*]Defense emblems now adds more defense to lower defense armours.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Can now collect the potion on choose the box treasure floor.
    [*]Another check implemented to see how many potions you should have before you start. (To make sure Gamer Gengar gets the right amount when going in.)
   
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1 part 2 is live
notes.content:
Version 1.06 released 

The council of Nine has been kind this week and added 3 new floors to the tower. 

These floors are all treasures floors, so no risk of dying! YAY.

The three new floors will just mix themselves into the current set of floors, so you have a chance of getting them no matter where you currently are in your climb to the top. 

[b][u]New Floors[/u][/b]

[b]Imp Race:[/b]
A nasty Imp loves treasure chests and is trying to beat you to them. There are 4 rare chests on this floor, and you have to beat the Imp to each one. 

If the Imp gets to them before you do, he steals the treasure within!

Also the Imp is a big cheat, and can't be killed... so don't try! 

[b]Puzzle floor:[/b]
Our first puzzle floor is live! You have 30 seconds to make all the lights blue. 

This is the first of the puzzle floors, and we plan to add more in the future. Some of these floors will be skippable. 

[b]Pick A Box:[/b]
3 items and 3 boxes, keep your eyes on the prize and they are shifted around and you get to pick one! 

That's not all – we have fixed some bugs! YAY

Next update will feature [i]BRAND NEW WEAPONS[/i], and maybe some more treasure and hell floors.

[b]New[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Race the imp treasure floor.
    [*]Make all blue treasure floor.
    [*]Choose a box treasure floor.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Added some health per level so you would not lose full health bonus with master on level up.
 
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug that could make wisps not work right.
    [*]Fixed a bug that made the floor not display correctly in tutorial.
    [*]Stopped a way of making the loot screen not send you to next floor on special floors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1 part 1 is now Live
notes.content:
Challenges and floor changes have now entered the Tower. This mysterious challenger wages bets on crusaders who enter the Tower to see if they have the bravery to beat his challenges.

 Can you beat the challenges and win the rewards?

 How challenge and floor change floors work:

 Before a floor a challenge icon will pop up letting you know a challenge is coming.

 
You could get any one of these challenges:
 [list]   
    [*]Don’t Block
    [*]Don’t evade
    [*]Break your shield
    [*]Don’t use a potion
    [*] Keep some stamina (don’t run out)
    [*] Take no damage
    [*]Break no scenery
    [*] Finish the floor in 20s/30s/40s
    [/list]
 Floor changes are slightly different in that they change the floor into something or give the floor a unique set up. A floor change can be any of these:
 [list]    
    [*]All enemies have regen (ouch right)
    [*]All bombs (every enemy will explode)
    [*]No loot (harsh!)
    [*]Tons of mines (watch your step yo!)
    [*]No traps (thank F@~%)
    [*]Enemies are weaker (sweet)
    [*]Enemies are stronger (typical)
    [*]Enemies die in one hit (YES! Get REKT enemies!)
    [*]All enemies drop health potions (you WHAT!?)
    [*]All enemies have triple HP (yep just to P£$% you off)
    [*]All enemies are slimes (hmm not bad)
    [*]All enemies are wisps (pretty good not bad)
    [*]All enemies are skeles (you can handle that right?)
    [*]All enemies are blocky (the golem with a b***h of a back slap)   
    [*]All enemies are orbits (get ready to dodge and block those... You love bullet hell though)
    [*] All enemies are imps (sorry DOMTRON)
    [*]All enemies are ghouls (if you haven’t battled these yet you will read this later and curse us)
    [*]All enemies are hounds (pretty harsh)
    [*]All enemies are nibbles (much like slimes but more annoying)
    [/list]
Please note you won’t get an all enemies floor if you haven’t come across the enemies so you can let out a sigh of relief as we won’t throw harder enemies at you if you haven’t came across them yet.

So for finishing a challenge (not a floor change) you’re rewarded with LOOOOOT

 The reward is random and can be any of these:
[list] 
 [*]1 chest with common item
 [*]2 chests with common items
 [*]1 rare chest
 [*]1 potion
 [*]5 potions
 [*]10 sword fragments
 [*]10 armour fragments
 [*]10 shield fragments
 [*]10 monster fragments
    [/list]
 Challenges are there to keep the gameplay slightly different and mix things up, we will of course be adding more in the future and will be listening to feedback!

We haven’t just done challenges though we have also changes and fixed some bugs! These changes are below:

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]   
 [*]Edited character sight to stop hindering vision near walls (screen would go black sometimes)
  [*]Enemies now have shadows
  [*]Altered the look of gold floors to look less flat
  [*]Smash the cart now works on level instead of floor (making it more of a challenge)
 [*]Increased the hit boxes of axe for the up and down attacks (to help with some people missing attacks)
   [/list]
 
[b] Bug fixes: [/b]
[list]
    [*]Soul Leech now correctly works when created with fragments.
    [*]Cart hit sounds have been fixed.
    [*]Will D Wisp will now stop cheating by attacking you while you were looking at loot.
   [/list]

notes.title: Thanks and Update 1 incoming
notes.content:
First off we want to say a huge thank you to anyone who has played the game and tried it out and also thanks to everyone who has given feedback. 

I’m not sure how many of you knew the game would get regularly updated but hopefully you will soon learn that and enjoy the additional content. 

Now the game has launched and things have calmed down a bit and nothing major needs patching we can focus on future content. 

We plan to release updates as and when they’re ready instead of sticking a lot of content together and releasing it as a patch we plan to work on one aspect, release it and then move to the next thing. This allows us to be very flexible about the direction we take and the ideas we put into Eternal Step. 

So get on with it already, what’s coming? 

[b] Update 1 part 1 [/b]

[b] Challenges [/b]

The first update will add challenges to the Tower; these challenges will appear at random as you climb. Between floors you will get an icon to tell you a challenge is coming on the next floor. 

Once on that floor you can see the challenge in the top right corner of the screen, fulfil the requirements and you earn some bonus LOOT. Fail it however… and, well nothing happens…we are not that cruel! 

Challenges can range from “ finish a floor in 60s” to “ don’t use potions” or “ don’t set off any traps”. These challenges will give you an extra goal to go for if you want to, but if you are too focused on climbing the Tower well then ignore them. 

The rewards for doing challenges will also be random, you may get a chest with loot, or a monster card, or a potion refill. So if you’re low on potions trying to do that challenge could mean life or death. Decisions!

We plan this update to go live pretty soon, hopefully by end of next week. We say that as a guide only, as there could be a bug or an issue that prevents it. 

After challenges the next piece of content will be new random floors like the survival and smash the cart floors. 

So keep an eye out for challenges appearing in the Tower soon!

notes.title: Eternal Step Launch – #DayOfTheStep Competition
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/K3SYLVS.jpg[/img]

Greetings, mortals!

[b]Eternal Step [/b]is out today, just in time for you to slay monsters all over Halloween. You play as a knight, who is atoning for his sins by climbing The Tower. Constructed with magic within, every time you play you encounter devious enemies, random floors and some horrendously tough bosses.

From now until Halloween, we're running a very special competition. Whoever can climb The Tower the highest will win their very own (cuddly and plush!) tombstone.

Each time you meet your demise within the tower, you are greeted with a tombstone stating how far you got in the game, and a little eulogy about how you died. 

[b]HOW TO ENTER[/b]
[list]
[*] Enter the Tower in [b]Eternal Step[/b]
[*] Fight many, many monsters
[*] Die. Lots. 
[*] On your death tombstone, enter in your name and tweet [url=https://twitter.com/EternalStep]@EternalStep[/url] and use the hashtag [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/DayOfTheStep]#DayOfTheStep[/url]
[*] After Halloween, we'll pick the winner!
[/list]

Screenshots of the tombstone will not be permitted - it will have to be tweeted directly from the game. 

[url=http://www.greenmangaming.com/terms-and-conditions/][b]Full terms and conditions can be found here[/b][/url], and the competition will end on Saturday October 31st 2015 at 23:59 UTC.

Oh, and there's also some extra special things in the game just for Halloween... Good luck. You'll need it. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NjKKjOs.gif?2[/img]
